snippet.description:

https://store.steampowered.com/app/5010630?utm_source=yt&utm_campaign=endemotrailer

https://x.com/bluesunflowerUA

Tunebound is a music band simulator about rising from the bottom to the top of the charts. Write songs, hire musicians, gain followers and climb from small gigs to sold-out stadiums. But fame is more than numbers: your choices shape your story and its ending. Will you stay true to yourself?
